# 2496. Maximum Value of a String in an Array

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maximumValue(self, strs):
        """
        :type strs: List[str]
        :rtype: int
        """
        return max([int(s) if s.isnumeric() else len(s) for s in strs])
```
